title: ctc-core: minimal algorithm core for CT colonography analysis
description: Headless algorithm core for CT colonography: body and gas masks with an adaptive hole fill, a bridge-graph and Fast Marching centerline, pericolonic fat mapping, distension and preparation descriptors, polyp measurement on a grayscale iso-surface, and the agreement statistics. Includes the pinned evaluation behind the IORN-012 manuscript: one entry point regenerates every table and figure from the public TCIA CT COLONOGRAPHY collection and the HQColon reference.
